---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#1D2347")
#let charcoal = rgb("#23272B")
#let slate = rgb("#3C454D")
#let mist = rgb("#DDE2E6")
#let sail = rgb("#F5F6F7")
#let pcss-gold = rgb("#FCD937")
#let pale-gold = rgb("#FFF9D9")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  flipped: true,
  margin: (top: 0.22in, bottom: 0.38in, x: 0.42in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(
      font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
      size: 6.4pt,
      fill: slate,
      hyphenate: false,
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 10pt,
      [Technology Commons - Weekly SMART Goal + Learning Skills],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(
  font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
  size: 9.6pt,
  fill: charcoal,
  hyphenate: false,
)
#set par(leading: 0.42em, justify: false)

#let write-line(stroke-color: slate) = line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.72pt + stroke-color)
#let rating-box() = rect(width: 0.25in, height: 0.15in, stroke: 0.8pt + navy, radius: 1pt)
#let check-box() = rect(width: 9pt, height: 9pt, stroke: 0.95pt + navy, radius: 1pt)

#let brand-header(title, subtitle) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 2.55in),
    column-gutter: 18pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 22pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#title]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 10.4pt, weight: "bold", fill: slate)[#subtitle]
    ],
    [
      #grid(
        columns: (0.54in, 1fr),
        column-gutter: 8pt,
        align: horizon,
        [#image("technology-department-emblem.svg", width: 0.50in)],
        [
          #text(size: 8.4pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons]
          #linebreak()
          #text(size: 7.5pt, fill: slate)[Port Credit Secondary School]
          #linebreak()
          #text(size: 7.3pt, weight: "bold", fill: slate)[May the Light Never Fail.]
        ],
      )
    ],
  )
  #v(2pt)
  #line(length: 0.70in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
  #v(1pt)
  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.25pt + navy)
]

#let info-row-score() = [
  #grid(
    columns: (auto, 1.32fr, auto, 0.82fr, auto, 0.92fr, auto),
    column-gutter: 6pt,
    align: horizon,
    [#text(size: 9.3pt, weight: "bold")[Name:]], [#write-line()],
    [#text(size: 9.3pt, weight: "bold")[Course:]], [#write-line()],
    [#text(size: 9.3pt, weight: "bold")[Week of:]], [#write-line()],
    [#text(size: 13pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[/20]],
  )
]

#let info-row() = [
  #grid(
    columns: (auto, 1.35fr, auto, 0.86fr, auto, 1fr),
    column-gutter: 6pt,
    align: horizon,
    [#text(size: 9.3pt, weight: "bold")[Name:]], [#write-line()],
    [#text(size: 9.3pt, weight: "bold")[Course:]], [#write-line()],
    [#text(size: 9.3pt, weight: "bold")[Week of:]], [#write-line()],
  )
]

#let field(label) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (auto, 1fr),
    column-gutter: 4pt,
    align: horizon,
    [#text(size: 7.6pt, weight: "bold", fill: charcoal)[#label]],
    [#write-line()]
  )
]

#let eval-row(label) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    column-gutter: 4pt,
    align: horizon,
    [#text(size: 6.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: charcoal)[#label]],
    [#rating-box()]
  )
]

#let evaluation-panel() = [
  #block(
    width: 100%,
    height: 100%,
    fill: pale-gold,
    stroke: 0.7pt + mist,
    radius: 3pt,
    inset: (x: 6pt, y: 4pt),
  )[
    #text(size: 7.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Evaluation]
    #v(2pt)
    #eval-row([Neatly Written])
    #v(2pt)
    #eval-row([Detailed Information])
    #v(2pt)
    #eval-row([Use of Technical Terms])
    #v(2pt)
    #eval-row([Level 1-4])
  ]
]

#let daily-box(day) = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 1.08in,
  stroke: 0.85pt + mist,
  radius: 4pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 5pt),
)[
  #grid(
    columns: (3.72in, 1fr, 1.82in),
    column-gutter: 12pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #grid(
        columns: (auto, 1fr),
        column-gutter: 5pt,
        align: horizon,
        [#text(size: 11.3pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#day]],
        [#text(size: 8.2pt, weight: "bold", fill: slate)[What is your goal today?]],
      )
      #v(2pt)
      #field([Specific:])
      #v(2pt)
      #field([Measurable (by end of class, I will have):])
      #v(2pt)
      #field([Attainable, Realistic, Timely:])
      #v(2pt)
      #field([Who did you work with?])
    ],
    [
      #text(size: 8.2pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[In detail, explain what you accomplished/learned today.]
      #v(4pt)
      #write-line()
      #v(8pt)
      #write-line()
      #v(8pt)
      #write-line()
    ],
    [#evaluation-panel()]
  )
]

#brand-header([Weekly SMART Goal & Progress Log], [Set the Goal. Follow the Way. Take Action.])
#v(2pt)
#info-row-score()
#v(3pt)
#grid(
  columns: (auto, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 10pt,
  align: horizon,
  [#text(size: 14.2pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Daily SMART Goals & Progress]],
  [#line(length: 100%, stroke: 2.3pt + pcss-gold)]
)
#v(3pt)

#daily-box([Monday])
#v(1pt)
#daily-box([Tuesday])
#v(1pt)
#daily-box([Wednesday])
#v(1pt)
#daily-box([Thursday])
#v(1pt)
#daily-box([Friday])

#pagebreak()

#let rating-panel() = [
  #block(
    width: 100%,
    height: 100%,
    fill: pale-gold,
    stroke: 0.7pt + mist,
    radius: 3pt,
    inset: (x: 7pt, y: 5pt),
  )[
    #text(size: 7.6pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[RATING]
    #v(4pt)
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, auto, auto, auto, auto, auto, auto, auto),
      column-gutter: 4pt,
      align: horizon,
      [#text(size: 8pt, weight: "bold")[E]], [#check-box()],
      [#text(size: 8pt, weight: "bold")[G]], [#check-box()],
      [#text(size: 8pt, weight: "bold")[S]], [#check-box()],
      [#text(size: 8pt, weight: "bold")[N]], [#check-box()],
    )
  ]
]

#let skill-row(title, prompt) = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 0.80in,
  stroke: 0.85pt + mist,
  radius: 4pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 5pt),
)[
  #grid(
    columns: (3.25in, 1fr, 1.80in),
    column-gutter: 12pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 10.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#title]
      #v(2pt)
      #text(size: 8.0pt, fill: slate)[#prompt]
    ],
    [
      #text(size: 8.4pt, weight: "bold", fill: charcoal)[How have you demonstrated and improved?]
      #v(4pt)
      #write-line()
      #v(8pt)
      #write-line()
    ],
    [#rating-panel()]
  )
]

#brand-header([Warrior Work Ethic: Proof of My Learning Skills], [How have you demonstrated and improved?])
#v(3pt)
#info-row()
#v(3pt)
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: sail,
  stroke: (left: 4pt + pcss-gold),
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 3pt),
)[
  #text(size: 8.4pt, weight: "bold", fill: slate)[E, G, S, N]
]
#v(4pt)

#skill-row([Responsibility], [Getting things done without anyone reminding you. Not just submitting tasks - but showing you're in control of your life.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Organization], [Keeping track of goals, tools & materials on your own. Using your planner/log so your life isn't chaos in a backpack.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Independent work], [Starting right away, staying focused, keeping goals. Figuring things out yourself before looking for help.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Initiative], [Doing what needs to be done without being asked/assigned. Asking good questions and seeking ways to grow.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Collaboration], [Being someone others actually want to work with. Helping others improve their weaknesses & learning from their strengths.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Self-regulation], [No phones unless absolutely necessary - you stay in control, not distracted. Finding the middle path and maintaining balance.])
```
